purpose: Teach: 君主/真空/放射能/被爆/高官/元来/堕落/精霊

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、外国君主制の影響を警察、考察されたんですね
lines.en: So the department has been considering the impact of foreign monarchy structures on this case?
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Steady eye contact. Posture upright but not rigid. Seeking confirmation with quiet respect for the process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の真空パック証拠を回収しました
lines.en: We recovered evidence from the scene—vacuum-sealed items, all catalogued.
lines.style: Factual, clipped delivery. No emotion attached. Speaking as someone reporting routine procedure. Slight pause between clauses for clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、放射能漏れの可能性を警察、検証中ですね
lines.en: So the department is still verifying the possibility of a radioactive leak in this matter?
lines.style: Curious but respectful. Leans in slightly. Genuine interest without impatience. Voice rises gently at the end as a question, not a demand.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被爆者の証言を慎重に伺っております
lines.en: We're hearing witness accounts from the exposed individuals very carefully.
lines.style: Deliberate pacing. Each word weighted. Quiet gravity—this is sensitive testimony. Slight downturn at the end, respectful pause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、高官関係者を警察、参考人として聴取されたんですね
lines.en: So the investigation has brought in high-ranking officials as persons of interest?
lines.style: Thoughtful, steady inquiry. Not accusatory—genuine attempt to understand the scope. Slight hesitation before 'high-ranking' like he's choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、元来の捜査方針を貫いております
lines.en: We're maintaining the investigative approach we've had from the start.
lines.style: Firm conviction without defensiveness. Steady voice. Slight emphasis on 'maintaining' and 'from the start'—showing consistency, not deviation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地域の堕落要因を警察、分析されたんですね
lines.en: Has the department analyzed the underlying factors contributing to the community's troubles?
lines.style: Thoughtful phrasing. Slightly longer breath before speaking. Searching for nuance. Lower register—this is a weighty question asked with real consideration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、神社の精霊像を盗難から守ります
lines.en: We're protecting the shrine's sacred statue from theft.
lines.style: Close, quiet declaration. Warm undertone beneath the professionalism. Voice drops slightly—this is personal duty, not just procedure. Finality in the tone.
